h1: Victoria + Albert bathroom installation on Wentworth Estate

hero.intro: We install luxury, fit-only bathrooms for homeowners on Wentworth Estate in Virginia Water, Surrey — the private, gated estate built around Wentworth Club and its golf courses, home of the BMW PGA Championship — around 15 to 20 minutes by road from our Bracknell base. A Victoria + Albert freestanding bath is a popular choice on these jobs, and because it's cast from a volcanic limestone and resin composite rather than acrylic or steel, it carries genuine weight, so we plan the floor loading, access route and waste position before it leaves the showroom, and coordinate access with the estate and any managing agent so the programme runs without delay at the gate.

sections.heading: Fit-only installation on a gated estate
sections.body: You source the sanitaryware, brassware, tiles and furniture; we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag, from £3,500. Working on Wentworth Estate means coordinating access with the estate and any managing agent as a standard part of the job, so that deliveries, our visits and the installation programme all run without delay at the gate. We build that coordination into the plan at survey stage rather than treating it as an afterthought once work is underway.

sections.heading: Why a Victoria + Albert bath needs careful planning
sections.body: Victoria + Albert's freestanding baths are cast from a volcanic limestone and resin composite, not acrylic or steel, which gives them a solid, cool-to-the-touch surface and genuine weight. That's a point that matters as much to how we get the bath into the room as it does to how it sits once installed. We plan the floor loading, the access route through the house, and the waste position before the bath leaves the showroom — and on an estate property, that planning also covers getting the bath through the gate and up the driveway without hold-ups.

sections.heading: What the installation covers
sections.body: Strip-out of the existing bathroom, first-fix plumbing with the waste positioned to suit the new Victoria + Albert bath, tiling, final plumbing connections and snagging once the room is finished. We don't supply the bath, basin, brassware, tiles or furniture — that stays with you — but we take full responsibility for getting it installed to a high standard, including the extra planning a composite-stone freestanding bath requires over a standard acrylic one.

sections.heading: Coordinating with estate management
sections.body: Many Wentworth Estate properties operate under estate or managing-agent oversight for access, deliveries and contractor working hours. We factor this into the installation programme from the outset, agreeing delivery windows and access arrangements before work starts, so the job runs smoothly within whatever conditions the estate requires.

sections.heading: Booking a survey on Wentworth Estate
sections.body: The process starts with a £125 survey, where we assess the room, confirm access arrangements through the estate, and agree the waste position for your Victoria + Albert bath. Installation then runs from £3,500 depending on scope. Call or WhatsApp 07399 651836 to arrange a visit.
